_note: The build the site offers. Update it with every release: the version, the installer and the zip on GitHub with their sizes as GitHub lists them in bytes (said in decimal MB, never rounded up) and SHA-256, the size of breadslicer.exe inside the zip, and the release post. `printers` is how many printer profiles that build has (without generic-machine). Then run `npm run data:printers`, which reads the profiles at the tag v<version>.
